meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: Claude 会变成数据处理专家:用 uv 运行 Python,始终带 numpy、不用 pandas;按操作类型自动选 DuckDB 或 Polars,经 Arrow 交换数据,能处理超内存的大文件,最后汇报耗时和行数。
howto.when: 当你说“分析这个文件”“汇总”“分组”等数据处理要求,或涉及 CSV/Parquet/JSON 等数据文件、SQL/DataFrame 操作时触发。纯文本阅读、配置文件或小型内联计算不触发。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件,按类别汇总销售额。
过滤出 orders.parquet 里金额超过 100 的行。
say.note: 会优先用 Polars 执行过滤,返回筛选后的表格。

say.text: 连接这两个数据集,去掉重复行并补全缺失值。
say.note: 会组合 DuckDB 与 Polars 完成连接和清洗。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a data specialist: it uses uv to run Python, always includes numpy and never pandas; it chooses DuckDB or Polars per operation, passes data via Arrow, handles datasets larger than RAM, and reports time and row counts.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to analyze a file, summarize, group, etc., or when handling CSV/Parquet/JSON data, SQL queries, or DataFrame operations. Not for plain-text reading, configs, or tiny inline math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and summarize sales by category.
say_en.note: It will group/aggregate via DuckDB or Polars and report time.

say_en.text: Filter rows in orders.parquet where amount is over 100.
say_en.note: It will likely use Polars and return the filtered table.

say_en.text: Join these two datasets, remove duplicates, and fill missing values.
say_en.note: It will combine DuckDB and Polars for join and cleaning.
